$comment1: MUA knowledge as data - FACE-GEOMETRY.md section 6. One canonical chart system: the classic contour-chart taxonomy (oval/round/square/long/heart/diamond/triangle). Editable without code; every rule carries source provenance.
$comment2: Copy rule: verbs about light and placement (lengthen, soften, lift, define). Never flaw language (fix, slim, problem, reduce). plan.ts validates verbs against this stance.
school: classic contour-chart taxonomy (single canonical system, cited)

contour.note: shorten the vertical read with light at the top and below the chin
light along the outer thirds for a lengthened read
round the corners with soft light at the angles
balance the upper width with light at the temples
soften the widest point along the cheekbone line
carry light up and away along the jaw line
balanced canvas: placement follows the feature, not a correction

brushDirections.jaw_L: jaw corner upward toward the ear
brushDirections.jaw_R: jaw corner upward toward the ear
brushDirections.cheek_shelf_L: ear toward the mouth corner, stop short
brushDirections.cheek_shelf_R: ear toward the mouth corner, stop short
brushDirections.cheek_apple: apples outward toward the temple at the blush angle
brushDirections.under_eye: inner corner outward, press don't drag
brushDirections.chin_ball: center of the chin, small circles
brushDirections.forehead_center: center of the forehead outward, feathered
brushDirections.cupid_bow: bow peak, one tap each side
brushDirections.nose_bridge: bridge of the nose, top down, one pass
